I didn't record 25 November as the Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date, because our records give a different date. I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread and asked where 25 November came from.

- **What the records say:** the renewal order form signed on 21 Nov 2025 sets the current term as 1 Dec 2025 to 30 Nov 2026. It names 30 Nov 2026 as the renewal date.
- **Account notes:** the Brackenwater account notes, last updated 30 Sep 2026, also give 30 Nov 2026 as the term end.
- **Possible explanation:** 25 November might be a target date for getting the renewal signed, not the date the term ends.

Until Ilse confirms, 30 Nov 2026 stays as the renewal date. My reply only mentioned dates, which anyone on the account's team can see, so it didn't include any of the contract's money terms.
